headline: OpenAI's Luna hits 22.7% — biggest single-model share on record
summary: openai/gpt-5.6-luna-20260709 just claimed an all-time token-share record at 22.7%, jumping 12.5 percentage points in a single day. OpenAI's provider share surged to 24.7%, while DeepSeek held steady at 21.4%. Four new models entered the top 50, and four older ones dropped out.
highlights: Top 2 (OpenAI + DeepSeek) now control 46.2% of tokens
New entrants: qwen/qwen3.8-max-20260902, thinkingmachines/inkling-20260715:free, mistralai/mistral-nemo, meta/muse-spark-1.3-20260902
Xiaomi's mimo-v2.5 climbed 17 ranks in 7 days to #6
